components.name: Arcade Lock Button
components.description: The dominant controller commitment for bluff and vote actions.
components.css: .ds-arcade-action { min-height: 3.5rem; width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.16rem var(--cream), 0 0.45rem 0 var(--orange-dark), 0 0 0 0.25rem var(--night); font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-arcade-action:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 0.2rem; } .ds-arcade-action:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Evidence Answer Key
components.description: A uniform cream native-radio key used in the fixed two-column phone answer pad.
components.css: .ds-answer-key { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 0.55rem; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); } .ds-answer-key input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; } .ds-answer-key:has(input:checked) { background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.18rem var(--cream), 0 0 0 0.36rem var(--yellow); }

components.name: CRT Screen
components.description: The single public state surface inside the orange apparatus.
components.css: .ds-crt { overflow: hidden; border: 1rem solid var(--night); border-radius: 2rem; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, oklch(0.27 0.07 218 / 0.48), transparent 68%), var(--screen); color: var(--phosphor); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.18rem var(--steel), inset 0 0 4rem oklch(0.02 0.03 248 / 0.8); }

components.name: Bureau Field Terminal
components.description: The persistent orange handheld casing around every private controller task.
components.css: .ds-terminal { width: min(100%, 34rem); min-height: calc(100svh - 5.2rem); border: 0.22rem solid var(--cream); border-radius: 2.4rem; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--orange); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-machine), 0 0 0 0.32rem var(--orange-dark); }

components.name: Film Drive
components.description: Persistent reel-to-reel evidence mechanism in the host instrument rail.
components.css: .ds-film-drive { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; background: var(--night); } .ds-film-drive i { width: 2rem; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--night) 0 13%, var(--cream) 14% 23%, var(--steel) 24% 42%, var(--night) 43% 52%, var(--steel-light) 53%); }

narrative.overview: A restrained late-1970s microfilm evidence theater. The passive host is one orange physical apparatus whose persistent film drive, CRT, lamps, knobs, evidence feed, and score drums process every game phase. The phone is a chunky Bureau field terminal with an antenna, inset display well, fixed 2×4 answer pad, confidence controls, and one arcade-scale lock action.
keyCharacteristics: One permanent orange machine, never a dashboard of themed panels.
Near-black CRT glass with phosphor truth, scanlines, and staged evidence routing.
Uniform cream evidence paddles with scarce yellow and phosphor signals.
Persistent reels, film path, bulbs, screws, knobs, and hard physical offsets.
A phone controller whose full decision architecture fits the first viewport.

rules.name: One Machine, Many States
rules.body: The chassis stays fixed while its active instrument changes; never frame phases as separate pages or equal cards.

rules.name: Signals Stay Scarce
rules.body: Cream keys and dark glass carry ordinary state; yellow marks selection, phosphor certifies truth, and red marks final commitment.

rules.name: Hardware Must Do a Job
rules.body: Every reel, lamp, knob, gate, and paddle must explain or carry game state.

rules.name: The Phone Is a Controller
rules.body: Keep confidence and commitment visible or unmistakably reachable; use key banks instead of long form stacks.

dos: Make the host read as a game-show prop at one glance.
Keep the film drive and orange chassis visible across every phase.
Stage truth, evidence, and score updates in legible beats.
Preserve native controls, visible focus, reduced motion, and 44px targets.
donts: Do not return to navy dashboard panels or paper-document card layouts.
Do not assign a different saturated color to every answer, rank, lamp, or decoration.
Do not hide confidence or Lock vote below an unbounded answer list.
Do not use motion or color as the sole representation of state.
Do not add host controls or move authority outside controllers.
